content_html: Maybe I’m missing something, but at that point aren’t you just testing an interface?

The above are not real tests. It is just a demonstration of NMock. If real tests, you would be testing a class that depends on an interface. You want to construct your class under test with an instance of the class you are mocking. To create this instance, use NMock.

It’s difficult using code examples because they can never be in complete context or the post would be a book!
